_evidence: 0x00431e58 reads the group's record count at +4 (0 skips the group, loop count otherwise) and walks records from +8 with stride 0x10: word +0 (scaled into +6) and word +2 (sign-split, clamped to +-0x3800, then fsincos/fpatan into +8). Count 0..8 keeps the walk inside this 136-byte group; the +2 list hits both sides of both clamps (two's-complement words).
